semantic_events.pre_evidence: get any scent that they want replicated
semantic_events.post_evidence: everyone has their own unique scent
semantic_events.rationale: Shared neighborhood of personalized scent access. PRE organizes around a replication-service frame (any scent can be reproduced on demand); POST organizes around a personal-uniqueness/ownership frame (each person has their own scent). Subsumption fails: owning a unique scent is not a specific way of getting any scent replicated. Frame shifts, territory persists. Reframed.

semantic_events.pre_evidence: relive moments in life with this scent
semantic_events.rationale: Same nostalgic-return territory, but the organizing frame shifts: PRE frames the return as 'moments in life' mediated by scent; POST frames it as 'memories' mediated by the products ('them'). The medium reference also shifts from 'scent' to 'them' (the bottles/products). No subsumption ('reliving memories is a specific way of reliving moments in life' is too loose to hold). Same territory, shifted frame. Reframed, not Elaborated (which would require the same frame with added detail).

semantic_events.pre_evidence: framing the brand vision in future/world terms (world where everyone has their own unique scent)
semantic_events.rationale: The future/world framing present in PRE (aspirational, world-building tone) is a meta-framing device that does not have a defensible POST successor in the POST concept set. The closest POST concept ('everyone has their own unique scent') is already matched as the successor of 'get any scent replicated' and cannot serve a second event. Recording as Removed rather than manufacturing a pairing.
